description: This file defines an interface IGrainDirectoryCache for caching grain directory entries, including methods for adding, removing, clearing, and looking up cache entries, as well as an extension method for simplified lookup.

classes.name: IGrainDirectoryCache
classes.description: Interface for caching grain directory entries with methods to add, remove, clear, and look up entries.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryCacheExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IGrainDirectoryCache, including a simplified lookup method.

methods.name: AddOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds a new entry or updates an existing entry in the cache with a specified version.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the cache by GrainId or GrainAddress.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: LookUp
methods.description: Retrieves a cached GrainAddress and its version by GrainId.

methods.name: LookUp (extension method)
methods.description: Simplified extension method to look up a GrainAddress by GrainId, returning a boolean indicating success.
